Backend: 12/12 pytest passed (100%) covering record-types listing, generation for record_of_advice / risk_profile_summary / product_comparison, validations (invalid record_type=400, invalid client_id=404), list+filter, single GET, 404 on bogus id, and DELETE with re-GET 404.
